thread:
jia: Heads up — running HF->Redwood tokenizer conversion for a new spm-based chat model and hit a subtle token-id offset that broke chat templates.

jia: Repro steps: downloaded model from HF, ran our convert_tokenizer.py, packed config.json, then smoke tests. Generation decodes but chat role markers map to wrong ids.

jia: Example snippet from token_ids for a sample: `['<|system|>', '<|user|>', 'Hello']` became `[50256, 4, 107]` but in the original spm vocab special tokens were at different positions (e.g., `<|system|>` was 3).

owen: ugh. likely an off-by-one or reserved-token insertion during merge creation. Did the converter reindex after merges?

jia: I inspected the merged vocab and saw that the converter prepended 3 synthetic tokens (`<pad>`, `<s>`, `</s>`) before the spm vocab, but HF model expected only `<unk>` in front. So indexes diverged.

sam: Can you paste the converter output config.json and the HF tokenizer JSON? small diff would help.

jia: Pasted minimal diffs:

```
// converter config.json (partial)
{"vocab_size": 50260, "special_tokens": {"pad_token": "<pad>", "unk_token": "<unk>", "bos_token": "<|system|>"}}
```

```
// HF tokenizer.json (partial)
{"model": {"type": "SentencePiece", "vocab_size": 50257}, "special_tokens_map": {"bos_token": "<|system|>", "eos_token": "<|end|>"}}
```

jia: Notice converter's vocab_size is +3 and it set pad/bos in front. HF's spm already encoded special tokens inside the model pieces, so the absolute ids don't match.

nora: Is this reproducible across other spm models or just this chat-kernel?

jia: Tried two more SPM models — same pattern when converter normalizes to a BPE-style indexed vocab. On one model we also saw token id collisions where an spm piece name reappeared as a special token alias and got a new id.

convert-bot: :gear: conversion-run 1769223345 finished with warnings: "special_token_reindexing"; see logs /mnt/ci/logs/1769223345-convert.log

owen: Potential fixes: (1) respect original spm id ordering (don't prepend synthetic tokens), (2) map special tokens by piece name -> id using spm's surface text, (3) preserve `token_type_ids` compatibility when building chat templates.

sam: Also watch unicode normalization — we saw the same wordpiece bytes split differently in spm vs our normalized preproc, which shifts ids during alignment.

jia: Actionable: I'll add a strict conversion mode that emits a token_id_map.json so serving can translate legacy ids at load time. Also will add a unit test that roundtrips chat templates (role markers) through conversion.

nora: +1. Can you also add a short eval to run a handful of canned prompts and assert decoded role markers are identical? That will catch regressions in quant/pack flows too.

jia: Yep. I'll open a PR with tests and the token_id_map output.

sam: Nice. For immediate mitigation we could add a fallback in runtime that remaps role ids if the model metadata `original_spm_order` is present. Low-risk and buys time.

jia: Good call. I'll prototype the runtime shim after the PR.

nowen: Thanks for catching this. Saved us from a subtle production regression where user messages would be decoded as system prompts. :sob:

convert-bot: :white_check_mark: ticket created: ML-5432 "spm->redwood tokenizer id offset & chat template remap"

jia: pinging @sam @nora for review once PR is up.

sam: will review tomorrow.

nora: I'll add an eval job to the nightly suite.

jia: closing loop here, will post PR link in this thread when ready. :rocket:
